patch_description: Instead of returning zeros, this implementation runs a deterministic multi-start pattern-search (compass search) optimizer directly on the min-triangle-area objective. Each starting configuration is generated from a fixed RNG seed; each point is perturbed with a geometrically decaying step size, projected back into the equilateral triangle (via barycentric clipping), and accepted only if the minimum normalized triangle area over all C(11,3)=165 triplets improves. Pattern search is derivative-free, robust to the non-smooth min-area objective, deterministic, and converges near locally-optimal Heilbronn configurations; multi-start guards against bad local optima. A guaranteed feasible fallback (interior points) handles any failure gracefully.
